adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained ~12 mm drop in N and ~2 mm drop in E around index 470–475 (P1), but no clear return; instead, values remain low through index 482. P2 at index 482 is an isolated point with large offsets (-10.7, -9.1, +5.0 mm) that does not form a platform (no preceding rise or following return). The interior of P1 (indices 471–474) shows persistent low values without recovery, inconsistent with a temporary offset platform. No opposing return across same axes observed. Thus neither P1 nor P2 qualifies as a genuine temporary platform.
